name: Vexer (Vanguard Archetype)
body:
Many warriors that learn the skills of a vanguard take up arms and use them to defend others. There are other avenues exemplified by the pious templar and the infused spellsword. However, there is still another supernatural subset of vanguards that learn ancient hexes that curse the enemies that dare to attack them. These vanguards are called vexers.

Class Skills: A vexer gains Knowledge (arcana), Spellcraft and Use Magic Device as class skills but lose Diplomacy, Knowledge (local), Knowledge (nobility), and Sense Motive as class skills. Due to their delving into ancient knowledge separating them from the world around them.

Vexing Mettle: The vexer gains the following new use for Mettle:

As part of using an ability or casting a spell with the curse descriptor, the vexer can expend a point of Mettle to increase the DC of the ability or spell by +1. At 5th level, and every 5 levels thereafter, the bonus to the DC increases by 1 to a maximum of +5 at 20th level. This bonus provided stacks with other feats or abilities that increase the DCs of such effects.

This ability modifies mettle but does not prevent the use of another archetype that modifies or replaces mettle.

Cursed Retribution (Su)

At 1st level, when an opponent makes an attack against the vexer or an ally within 30 feet, the vexer can, as an immediate action, spend a point of Mettle to lay a curse upon the target. The target must make a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 the vexer’s class level + their Charisma modifier) or take a -4 penalty to one of the following (vexer’s choice): AC, ability checks, attack rolls, saving throws, or skill checks. This ability lasts for 1d6 rounds. If the target succeeds on their saving throw, they instead take a -2 penalty to the chosen AC or check for 1d4 rounds. This is a curse effect.

This ability replaces valorous deflection.

Spellcasting

A vexer casts spells from the lathspell spell list. A vexer uses Charisma to determine the saving throws of spells they cast and to determine bonus spells per day. The vexer prepares and casts spells like a lathspell and they use the same spell progression.

Unlike many arcane spellcasters, a vexer suffers no arcane spell failure when casting vexer spells in light or medium armor or while wearing a buckler or light shield The somatic components for a vexer can be performed while wielding a weapon. They predominantly consist of ancient words and hard movements that work well with martial combat.

This ability replaces trial by combat, armor training, bulwark, and second skin.

Older and Darker Knowledge (Ex)

The vexer’s training includes delving into dark rituals and understanding the old and forgotten magics. At 2nd level, the vexer’s understanding of such subjects grows. They gain a bonus equal to 1/2 their vexer class levels on Knowledge (arcana), Spellcraft and Use Magic Device checks.

Additionally, this allows the vanguard to make Knowledge (arcana) checks untrained without the normal maximum result of 10.

This ability replaces aristocratic training.

Ward of Misfortune (Su)

At 3rd level, the vexer may place a protective ward on a target. As a free action when rolling initiative, the vexer may select a target within 30 feet, besides themself, to receive this protective ward. The selection may not change for the duration of the encounter but fades after 10 minutes, the ward is triggered or when another ward is placed. If the subject is dealt damage or affected by a hostile effect, the attacker must make a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 the vexer’s class level + their Charisma modifier) or be struck by grave misfortune. For 1 round plus 1 per 4 class levels, anytime the attacker makes an ability check, attack roll, saving throw, or skill check, it must roll twice and take the worse result. On a successful Will save, the attacker is unaffected and the ward is not triggered. This is a curse effect.

This ability replaces behind me.

Matched Wounds (Su)

At 7th level, the vexer learns ancient rites to curse creatures for violent tendencies. By spending a point of mettle as a standard action, the vexer can mark a target with a curse of matched wounds for 1 minute. Each time the creature deals damage, they must make a Fortitude save (DC 10 + 1/2 the vexer’s class level + their Charisma modifier) or take equal damage of the same type dealt. This damage is not reduced by DR the attacking creature possesses, and if the creature has resistance or immunity to the damage dealt, the damage is halved but dealt as untyped damage. A successful saving throw negates the damage for the single instance. This is a curse effect.

This ability replaces press the advantage.

Dire Retribution (Su)

At 12th level, when using curse of retribution, it applies to all the options instead of the single choice. Additionally, the vexer can end the curse prematurely as an immediate action to increase the penalty on a single roll to equal their class level.

This ability replaces improved press the advantage.

Master of the Ancient Rites (Su)

The vexer has become a scion of the battlefield and a bearer of ancient magics. At 20th level, the vexer gains a constant aura that imposes a -2 penalty on the Will saves of all creatures within 10 feet. They no longer need to expend Mettle to activate test of valor or curse of retribution, though, to gain the benefits of dire retribution, they must expend a point of Mettle.

This ability replaces protector of the realm.
